looks.label: Dev tree, variant t2 at 3150, draft, 960 px (tall tops, fill by the open sky, matter floor 0.03, no solve). Darkness by cast shade works and edges stand 0.12 units before their ground, but it reads as rock and the low band is 25.3 (state s 9.27)

Dev tree, variant t4 at 3150, draft, 960 px (round towers 0.36 units wide, fill by the open sky, matter floor 0.03, no solve). Not film grade: reads as boulders, not cloud; the ceiling flattens the fine billows. Kept only as a step
Series A, state s, capture frame 6300 (film 3150), draft, 960 px. Matter floor 0.016. Low band whole frame 9.27, outside the seven cells 8.75

Series A, state s, four of the 60 frames at 60 a second (film 3135, 3142, 3149, 3156), draft, V 0.0165. Not film grade yet: reads as wet clay, tops hardly slide against depths (0.26 px a film frame at 1.5 units against a design of 0.82)
state s, 3150 at preview size, draft: matter's floor 0.016, three solve rounds; low band 9.27 whole frame, 8.75 outside the seven cells; bands 1.15 1.10 0.99 0.90

state s laid back on the ground chart (camera taken out), 3060 beside 3239, rings at 0.45, 0.9, 1.6 and 2.5 units: turn of the picture by ring 0.13 0.42 0.98 0.99 0.70 0.44 0.25 0.11 0.08 degrees a second, the flow law 0.41 0.83 1.15 1.15 0.82 0.46 0.23 0.13 0.10
state s, frames 3060, 3149.5 and 3239 at preview size, draft: the ground by code from three eye points

3150 master draft, state r: round tops and cast shadows (q6) after three solve rounds with the brightening capped. Low band 11.259 (main 3.539, state n 4.801), bands 1.11 1.05 0.96 0.90. Reads as a cumulus deck; the storm is lumpy and too dark, heads too big
3150 preview draft, state q6: round tops on every age, softer cast shadows, no solve yet. First state that reads as cumulus
3150 preview draft, state q4: taller tops with plateaus. Eroded rock, wrong; the cast shadows darken the lower left by the Sun alone
3150 preview draft, state q3: waves 0.12 units and a flatter spectrum. Finer streaks along the streamlines, still rock
3150 preview draft, state q1: uncut unrest gates the billows, hue law, no solve yet. Lumps of 100 px and more, reads as terrain

3150 draft state n: billows gated by the guide's own unrest (far field calm, streaks), lanes take the matter's hue, solve by range; low band 4.801 (main 3.539), plain 14.7584, bands 0.93 0.92 0.87 0.86 (under 1 px 1.19), 146.8 s; soft glows of the solve in the lower left, lower right 30 against 8
3150 preview state v1: state k with the floor of the matter's light at 0.07 (no matter darker than a dark cloud): low band 28.98 at preview size; the right third and the bottom lit pale blue

3150 draft state k: guide solved by range in four damped rounds, low band 5.547 (main 3.539), plain 15.9608, bands 1.00 0.99 0.93 0.86 (under 1 px 1.29), 138.9 s; limb ragged, far field lumpy, lower right 30 against 8
3150 preview state j1: the plain guide with no solve, relief from the plain guide, low band 17.42 at preview size
3150 draft state i, BAD: blotches and teal (old solve through the fit camera, two rounds), low band 14.7885, plain 23.3755, bands 1.08 1.09 1.11 1.21

3150 draft, third state before the solve (relief by code: funnel, crest, lanes from the guide; rounded tops of three ages; fill 0.26): low band 17.541, plain 24.2426, bands 1.01 1.02 1.03 1.06, 126 s. Wrong: lumps where the approved image has sheared spiral bands, too dark on the left

3150 draft, third state, albedo solved once under the code's light with a floor of 0.07 (no darkness in the guide): low band 28.2625, plain 36.1885, bands 1.18 1.25 1.31 1.37. Bad: the lower right is lit and turns teal, relief still lumps, no spiral bands yet

3150 at draft, second state, a bad one on purpose: the code's detail is now height (the march runs through it), lit on its slopes by the one Sun through the deck's curve, with cast shadows marched toward the Sun and one fill. It reads as rock, not cloud (peaked tops, too steep, too large), and far too dark: low band 21.55 (main 3.539), bands 1.21 1.24 1.21 1.15 (inside 0.7 to 1.4), plain 28.61. 66 s at draft. Next: rounded tops, ridges along the streamlines as height, a guide without painted light

3150 at draft, first state of the new ground, with the three numbers: low band 8.81 (main 3.539), bands 1 to 2: 0.52, 2 to 4: 0.50, 4 to 8: 0.52, 8 to 16: 0.67 (all red, line is 0.7 to 1.4), plain 14.10. Share by the page 1.26. Bad: detail is fur, no relief, no shadows, oval without bands. Relief and light are next
3239 at draft, first state of the new ground. Low band 12.57, bands 0.52 0.50 0.52 0.67. Share by the page 1.26

3060 at draft, first state of the new ground (stage 1: guide, flow, code detail, old light). Low band 13.68, bands 0.52 0.50 0.52 0.66 against the approved 3150. Share of detail by code as the page defines it 1.25: over 1, because the flat guide colour is brighter than the dark ground, so the measure needs the ground alone and the guide alone beside it; both follow
3150 at draft, first state of the new ground: no eye, the guide (cut 0.08 units), the flow, code detail carried in three ages of wound coordinates. Light still as before, no slopes, no shadows
